correctness.rationale: Uniform ancestry-chain representation is exact, including integer window cap. Nonincreasing potential increments give a pathwise martingale plus nonnegative error. A each-boundary-crossed-at-most-once argument bounds total error by O_beta(log n). Conditional jump variance tends to 1/3; martingale CLT and optional isometry prove the Gaussian and variance laws. An independent exhaustive finite check passed 973 tests; infinite proof does not depend on finite extrapolation.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The scaled-attachment paper assumes parent index floor(i X_i) with an i.i.d. proportion X_i and obtains logarithmic depths; this is not the deterministic shrinking relative interval of size i^beta. Standard martingale CLT is broader methodology, but does not by itself prove the state-dependent error bound and constants. An unindexed general Markov renewal theorem remains a real risk.
